release_name: Live TV v5.1.1 — Smooth Channel Browsing, Sticky Category Header & Mobile AI Enhancer
min_os_mac: macOS 11.0 Big Sur or later (Apple Silicon)
changelog: 🚀 Fixed Channel Browsing & Scrolling Access: Unblocked root scroll container enabling smooth, lightning-fast access down to all 2,989 channels and auto-loading lazy-batches
📌 Pinned Sticky Category Bar & Quick Counts: Categories and live channel counter now smoothly stick to the top during catalog scrolling for effortless category jumping
🎬 Collapsible Hero Broadcast Billboard: Compact 140px featured broadcast hero with 1-click dismiss (✕) and quick Billboard toggle button in the browser tools bar

📱 Fixed Mobile Remote AI Video Enhancer in Fullscreen: Re-engineered phone player with Container Fullscreen and iOS Immersive Fullscreen Mode (100vw x 100vh) preventing iOS QuickTime and Android media engines from stripping AI sharpening and color grading filters
✨ Hardware-Accelerated Mobile WebGL AI Super-Resolution Engine: Ported zero-latency 60fps GPU WebGL Sobel convolution, high-pass sharpening, and HDR tone mapping directly to mobile phones and tablets
⚖️ Mobile Interactive Split-Screen Comparison Slider: Real-time touch-draggable divider on mobile phone player to compare Native 1080p vs AI 4K live during playback
🪟 In-Video Floating Fullscreen HUD & Gestures: Auto-dimming on-screen controls in fullscreen with one-tap AI mode switching, double-tap to toggle fullscreen, and vertical swipe channel surfing
🎙️ Mobile Voice Assistant & Search: Integrated Web Speech recognition allowing hands-free channel tuning, muting, and AI cycling directly from the phone remote
🌙 Pure OLED Pitch-Black Mode: Battery-saving true #000000 background mode saving up to 40% display power on mobile OLED and Super AMOLED screens
⛶ Aspect Ratio Pan & Zoom Controller: Cycle between 16:9 Fit, 16:9 Fill Zoom (no black bars), 4:3 Vintage Pillarbox, and 21:9 Ultra-Wide Cinema on Mac and Mobile
⚡ Real-Time Network CDN Latency & Stability Telemetry: Live ping monitor and dropped-frame watchdog on player HUD ensuring seamless jitter-free broadcasts
🛡️ 100% Ad-Free Live TV (Zero-Ad Shield): Completely clean broadcast without commercial interruptions, popup ads, or tracking scripts
